u = regDiff(data, alpha) performs first-order TV-regularized differentiation of data using the regularization parameter alpha.

[u,v] = regDiff(data, alpha, alpha2) performs first- and second-order TV-regularized differentiation of data using (in order) the regularization parameters alpha and alpha2.

[u,v] = regDiff(rawdata, alpha, alpha2, dx, u0, minIter, maxIter, deltacosttol, deltanormtol, ep, skip_first_deriv_flag, plotflag, diagflag) performs first-and second-order TV-regularized differentiation and allows the following properties to be set:

dx: Data spacing. Default is 1.
u0: Initial guess of derivatives as a cell array or matrix. By default performs central differencing on input data.
minIter: Minimum number of iterations. Default is 5.
maxiter: Maximum number of iterations. Default is 100000.
deltacosttol: Minimum norm of normalized cost. Value below this value terminates solver. Default is 1e-6.
deltanormtol: Minimum norm of normalized increment. Value below this value terminates solver. Default is 1e-6.
ep: Parameter for avoiding division by zero. Default is 1e-6.
skip_first_deriv_flag: Flag whether to skip calculating the first derivative. If true, u0 must be provided. Default is false.
plotflag: Flag whether to display plot at each iteration. Default is false.
diagflag: Flag whether to display diagnostics at each iteration.
